fields.title: 2. Congressional Event of the Same Week — Himes Letter (T7 ⓗ New)
fields.md:
| Item | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Report | CNN 2026-11-20 18:42 UTC (Cohen·Hansler·Atwood) | [CNN (Yahoo repost)](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-intel-chief-warned-no-184233055.html) |
| Sender | House Intelligence Committee's Himes — a member who 'will become chair in 2027-01' | Same |
| To DNI Clayton (private) | "our committee cannot authorize funds for the development of government systems" | Same |
| To the CEO | "Explain the changes that were made to the Starshield service in October 2026" · "It is difficult for me to continue supporting the authorization of funding" · meeting requested | Same |
| Deadline | None | Same · [Newsweek](https://newsweek.com/spacex-funding-threat-ukraine-satellite-dispute-12750525) |
| Letter date | 11/20 (Newsweek wrote that it viewed the letter) | [Newsweek](https://newsweek.com/spacex-funding-threat-ukraine-satellite-dispute-12750525) |
| Target systems | 'SpaceX-developed, government-owned systems' — no system names or amounts | CNN · Newsweek |
| Reaction | SpaceX did not respond. Ukraine's chargé d'affaires Sienik — Kyiv is in contact with the Defense Ministry and there has been no response from SpaceX | CNN |

- **Reading**: The member who will become next year's Intelligence Committee chair warned that he would withhold support for authorizing systems developed by SpaceX and owned by the government. This is neither a vote, a budget cut, nor a contract action. The text of the letter has also not been made public. Review of the Intelligence Authorization Act (IAA) comes after 2027-01. The checkpoint is whether the relevant budget line actually changes then (source: CNN 11/20 · `state.triggers_next_12m[T7].paths[h]`).
